<solution verdict="run">
bash -s <<'EOF'
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /workspace/flat
if [[ -e /workspace/nested ]]; then
  declare -A used=()
  while IFS= read -r -d '' src; do
    base=${src##*/}
    cand=$base
    n=0
    while [[ -e "/workspace/flat/$cand" || -L "/workspace/flat/$cand" || -n "${used[$cand]:-}" ]]; do
      n=$((n+1))
      cand="${base}_${n}"
    done
    used[$cand]=1
    mv -- "$src" "/workspace/flat/$cand"
  done < <(find -H /workspace/nested -type f -print0 | LC_ALL=C sort -z)
fi
EOF
</solution>

SRC = '/workspace/archive.tar'

    while name.startswith('./'):

        name = name[1:]
    if name.endswith('/'):
        name = name[:-1]
    return name

def get_name(hdr):
    name = hdr[:100].split(b'\0', 1)[0]
    prefix = hdr[345:500].split(b'\0', 1)[0]
    if prefix and hdr[257:262] == b'ustar':
        name = prefix + b'/' + name
    return name.decode('utf-8', 'surrogateescape')

    field = hdr[124:136]
    if field and (field[0] & 0x80):
        return int.from_bytes(field[1:], 'big')
    s = field.split(b'\0', 1)[0].split(b' ', 1)[0]
    return int(s, 8) if s else 0

def blocks_for(size):
    return (size + BLOCK - 1) // BLOCK

def checksum_header(hdr):
    h = bytearray(hdr)
    h[148:156] = b'        '
    total = sum(h)
    h[148:156] = format(total, '06o').encode('ascii') + b'\0 '
    return bytes(h)

def make_header(hdr, size, typeflag, clear_linkname=False):
    h = bytearray(hdr)
    octal = format(size, 'o')
    if len(octal) <= 11:
        h[124:136] = octal.rjust(11, '0').encode('ascii') + b'\0'
    else:
        raw = size.to_bytes(12, 'big')
        h[124:136] = bytes([raw[0] | 0x80]) + raw[1:]
    h[156:157] = typeflag
    if clear_linkname:
        h[157:257] = b'\0' * 100
    return checksum_header(bytes(h))

    lines = old.splitlines(keepends=True)
    out = []
    replaced = False
    for line in lines:
        m = re.match(rb'^(\s*)mode\s*=\s*', line)

            if line.endswith(b'\r\n'):
                ending = b'\r\n'
            elif line.endswith(b'\n') or line.endswith(b'\r'):
                ending = line[-1:]
            else:
                ending = b''
            out.append(m.group(1) + b'mode=prod' + ending)
            replaced = True
        else:
            out.append(line)
    if not replaced:
        if old and not old.endswith(b'\n'):
            out.append(b'\n')
        out.append(b'mode=prod\n')
    return b''.join(out)

except Exception:

n = len(data)
while i + BLOCK <= n:

    size = parse_size(hdr)
    typeflag = hdr[156:157]
    data_start = i + BLOCK

    members.append((i, name, size, typeflag, data_start, data_end))
    i = data_end

if not members:

    for idx, m in enumerate(members):
        if norm_name(m[1]).rsplit('/', 1)[-1] == 'config.ini' and m[3] in CONVERTIBLE:
            target_idx = idx
            break
if target_idx is None:
    sys.exit('config.ini not found in archive')

out = []

    i, name, size, typeflag, data_start, data_end = m
    hdr = data[i:i + BLOCK]
    if idx == target_idx:

def make_pax_record(key, value):
    base = 1 + len(key) + 1 + len(value) + 1
    for digits in range(1, 10):
        length = base + digits
        if len(str(length)) == digits:
            return (str(length) + ' ' + key.decode('ascii') + '=' + value.decode('ascii') + '\n').encode('ascii')
    raise ValueError('PAX record too long')

def update_pax_size(pax_data, new_size):
    lines = pax_data.splitlines(keepends=True)
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        if re.match(rb'^\d+ size=', line):
            out.append(make_pax_record(b'size', str(new_size).encode('ascii')))
        else:
            out.append(line)
    return b''.join(out)

        name = name[1:]
    if name.endswith('/'):

    return name

    s = field.split(b'\0', 1)[0].split(b' ', 1)[0]

    h[148:156] = b'        '
    total = sum(h)
    h[148:156] = format(total, '06o').encode('ascii') + b'\0 '

SRC = '/workspace/archive.tar'

        name = name[2:]
    if name.startswith('/'):
        name = name[1:]
    if name.endswith('/'):
        name = name[:-1]
    return name

    if field and (field[0] & 0x80):
        return int.from_bytes(field[1:], 'big')
    s = field.split(b'\0', 1)[0].split(b' ', 1)[0]
    return int(s, 8) if s else 0

def blocks_for(size):
    return (size + BLOCK - 1) // BLOCK

def checksum_header(hdr):
    h = bytearray(hdr)
    h[148:156] = b'        '
    total = sum(h)
    h[148:156] = format(total, '06o').encode('ascii') + b'\0 '

    h[156:157] = typeflag
    return checksum_header(bytes(h))

        out.append(b'mode=prod\n')
    return b''.join(out)

import sys, re, io, tarfile

SRC = '/workspace/archive.tar'
DST = '/workspace/new.tar'
BLOCK = 512

data = open(SRC, 'rb').read()

def norm_name(name):
    while name.startswith('./'):
        name = name[2:]
    if name.startswith('/'):
        name = name[1:]
    if name.endswith('/'):
        name = name[:-1]
    return name

def get_name(hdr):
    name = hdr[:100].split(b'\0', 1)[0]
    prefix = hdr[345:500].split(b'\0', 1)[0]
    if prefix and hdr[257:262] == b'ustar':
        name = prefix + b'/' + name
    return name.decode('utf-8', 'surrogateescape')

def parse_size(hdr):
    field = hdr[124:136]
    if field and (field[0] & 0x80):
        return int.from_bytes(field[1:], 'big')
    s = field.split(b'\0', 1)[0].split(b' ', 1)[0]
    return int(s, 8) if s else 0

def blocks_for(size):
    return (size + BLOCK - 1) // BLOCK

def checksum_header(hdr):
    h = bytearray(hdr)
    h[148:156] = b'        '
    total = sum(h)
    h[148:156] = format(total, '06o').encode('ascii') + b'\0 '
    return bytes(h)

def make_header(hdr, size, typeflag, clear_linkname=False):
    h = bytearray(hdr)
    octal = format(size, 'o')
    if len(octal) <= 11:
        h[124:136] = octal.rjust(11, '0').encode('ascii') + b'\0'
    else:
        raw = size.to_bytes(12, 'big')
        h[124:136] = bytes([raw[0] | 0x80]) + raw[1:]
    h[156:157] = typeflag
    if clear_linkname:
        h[157:257] = b'\0' * 100
    return checksum_header(bytes(h))

def transform_config(old):
    lines = old.splitlines(keepends=True)
    out = []
    replaced = False
    for line in lines:
        m = re.match(rb'^(\s*)mode\s*=\s*', line)
        if m:
            if line.endswith(b'\r\n'):
                ending = b'\r\n'
            elif line.endswith(b'\n') or line.endswith(b'\r'):
                ending = line[-1:]
            else:
                ending = b''
            out.append(m.group(1) + b'mode=prod' + ending)
            replaced = True
        else:
            out.append(line)
    if not replaced:
        if old and not old.endswith(b'\n'):
            out.append(b'\n')
        out.append(b'mode=prod\n')
    return b''.join(out)

target_offset = None
try:
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data), mode='r') as tf:
        tf_members = tf.getmembers()
        regular = (tarfile.REGTYPE, tarfile.AREGTYPE)

        for exact in (True, False):
            for types in (regular, convertible):
                for m in tf_members:

                    if (name == 'config.ini' if exact else name.rsplit('/', 1)[-1] == 'config.ini') and m.type in types:
                        target_offset = m.offset
                        break
                if target_offset is not None:
                    break
            if target_offset is not None:
                break
except Exception:
    target_offset = None

members = []
i = 0
n = len(data)
while i + BLOCK <= n:
    hdr = data[i:i + BLOCK]
    if hdr == b'\0' * BLOCK:
        break
    name = get_name(hdr)
    size = parse_size(hdr)
    typeflag = hdr[156:157]
    data_start = i + BLOCK
    data_end = data_start + blocks_for(size) * BLOCK
    if data_end > n:
        break
    members.append((i, name, size, typeflag, data_start, data_end))
    i = data_end

if not members:
    sys.exit('No tar members found')

target_idx = None
if target_offset is not None:
    for idx, m in enumerate(members):
        if m[0] == target_offset:
            target_idx = idx
            break

CONVERTIBLE = (b'0', b'\0', b'1', b'2', b'5')
if target_idx is None:
    for idx, m in enumerate(members):
        if norm_name(m[1]) == 'config.ini' and m[3] in (b'0', b'\0'):
            target_idx = idx
            break
if target_idx is None:
    for idx, m in enumerate(members):
        if norm_name(m[1]) == 'config.ini' and m[3] in CONVERTIBLE:
            target_idx = idx

if target_idx is None:
    for idx, m in enumerate(members):
        if norm_name(m[1]).rsplit('/', 1)[-1] == 'config.ini' and m[3] in (b'0', b'\0'):
            target_idx = idx

if target_idx is None:
    for idx, m in enumerate(members):
        if norm_name(m[1]).rsplit('/', 1)[-1] == 'config.ini' and m[3] in CONVERTIBLE:
            target_idx = idx
            break
if target_idx is None:
    sys.exit('config.ini not found in archive')

out = []
for idx, m in enumerate(members):
    i, name, size, typeflag, data_start, data_end = m
    hdr = data[i:i + BLOCK]
    if idx == target_idx:
        old = data[data_start:data_start + size]
        new = transform_config(old)
        if new == old and typeflag in (b'0', b'\0'):
            out.append(hdr)
            out.append(data[data_start:data_end])
        else:
            new_type = typeflag if typeflag in (b'0', b'\0') else b'0'
            clear_linkname = typeflag not in (b'0', b'\0')
            out.append(make_header(hdr, len(new), new_type, clear_linkname))
            out.append(new + b'\0' * ((BLOCK - len(new) % BLOCK) % BLOCK))
    else:
        out.append(hdr)
        out.append(data[data_start:data_end])

tail = data[i:]
if not tail:
    tail = b'\0' * (2 * BLOCK)
out.append(tail)

with open(DST, 'wb') as f:
    f.write(b''.join(out))

def make_pax_record(key, value):
    base = 1 + len(key) + 1 + len(value) + 1
    for digits in range(1, 10):
        length = base + digits
        if len(str(length)) == digits:
            return (str(length) + ' ' + key.decode('ascii') + '=' + value.decode('ascii') + '\n').encode('ascii')
    raise ValueError('PAX record too long')

def update_pax_size(pax_data, new_size):
    lines = pax_data.splitlines(keepends=True)
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        if re.match(rb'^\d+ size=', line):
            out.append(make_pax_record(b'size', str(new_size).encode('ascii')))
        else:
            out.append(line)
    return b''.join(out)
```

def norm_name(name):
    while name.startswith('./'):
        name = name[2:]
    if name.startswith('/'):
        name = name[1:]
    if name.endswith('/'):
        name = name[:-1]
    return name

def get_name(hdr):
    name = hdr[:100].split(b'\0', 1)[0]
    prefix = hdr[345:500].split(b'\0', 1)[0]
    if prefix and hdr[257:262] == b'ustar':
        name = prefix + b'/' + name
    return name.decode('utf-8', 'surrogateescape')

def parse_size(hdr):
    field = hdr[124:136]
    if field and (field[0] & 0x80):
        return int.from_bytes(field[1:], 'big')
    s = field.split(b'\0', 1)[0].split(b' ', 1)[0]
    return int(s, 8) if s else 0

def blocks_for(size):
    return (size + BLOCK - 1) // BLOCK

def checksum_header(hdr):
    h = bytearray(hdr)
    h[148:156] = b'        '
    total = sum(h)
    h[148:156] = format(total, '06o').encode('ascii') + b'\0 '
    return bytes(h)

def make_header(hdr, size, typeflag, clear_linkname=False):
    h = bytearray(hdr)
    octal = format(size, 'o')
    if len(octal) <= 11:
        h[124:136] = octal.rjust(11, '0').encode('ascii') + b'\0'
    else:

        h[124:136] = bytes([raw[0] | 0x80]) + raw[1:]
    h[156:157] = typeflag

    return checksum_header(bytes(h))

import sys, re, io, tarfile

SRC = '/workspace/archive.tar'
DST = '/workspace/new.tar'
BLOCK = 512

data = open(SRC, 'rb').read()

CONVERTIBLE = (b'0', b'\0', b'1', b'2', b'5')

def norm_name(name):
    while name.startswith('./'):
        name = name[2:]
    if name.startswith('/'):
        name = name[1:]
    if name.endswith('/'):
        name = name[:-1]
    return name

def get_name(hdr):
    name = hdr[:100].split(b'\0', 1)[0]
    prefix = hdr[345:500].split(b'\0', 1)[0]
    if prefix and hdr[257:262] == b'ustar':
        name = prefix + b'/' + name
    return name.decode('utf-8', 'surrogateescape')

def parse_size(hdr):
    field = hdr[124:136]
    if field and (field[0] & 0x80):
        return int.from_bytes(field[1:], 'big')
    s = field.split(b'\0', 1)[0].split(b' ', 1)[0]
    return int(s, 8) if s else 0

def blocks_for(size):
    return (size + BLOCK - 1) // BLOCK

def checksum_header(hdr):
    h = bytearray(hdr)
    h[148:156] = b'        '
    total = sum(h)
    h[148:156] = format(total, '06o').encode('ascii') + b'\0 '
    return bytes(h)

def make_header(hdr, size, typeflag, clear_linkname=False):
    h = bytearray(hdr)
    octal = format(size, 'o')
    if len(octal) <= 11:
        h[124:136] = octal.rjust(11, '0').encode('ascii') + b'\0'
    else:
        raw = size.to_bytes(12, 'big')
        h[124:136] = bytes([raw[0] | 0x80]) + raw[1:]
    h[156:157] = typeflag
    if clear_linkname:
        h[157:257] = b'\0' * 100
    return checksum_header(bytes(h))

def transform_config(old):
    lines = old.splitlines(keepends=True)
    out = []
    replaced = False
    for line in lines:
        m = re.match(rb'^(\s*)mode\s*=\s*', line)
        if m:
